form.hint: Click or drag components from the palette to the canvas — fields are created instantly with automatic names, edit them via the property drawer. Click a card to select it; Delete/Backspace removes the selected card.
form.canvasEmpty: Empty canvas — add components from the palette.
form.resetBody: Clear the entire canvas? All fields, sections/dividers, and sample data will be deleted and cannot be restored.

config.parentHint: Options from registered parent modules. Pick (root) for a top-level module.
config.newParentHint: Nesting with slash is supported, e.g. finance/accounting.
config.permissionTouched: Single value without dots — suffixes .view/.create/.update/.delete/.bulk_upload/.export are automatic.
config.permissionAuto: Auto-derived from module name — type to override manually.

configValidate.permissionPattern: Permission key must be a single value: lowercase, numbers, underscore, starting with a letter (e.g. user, generator, dashboard, audit_trail). No dots.
configValidate.bulkNeedsList: Bulk upload and export need the list feature.
configValidate.bulkNeedsField: Bulk upload needs at least one non-file and non-array field.
configValidate.fieldNameReserved: Field name "{{name}}" is reserved for system columns.
configValidate.fieldRuleNumeric: Field "{{name}}" rule {{rule}} needs a numeric value.
configValidate.fieldRuleRegex: Field "{{name}}" rule regex has an invalid pattern.
configValidate.fieldSource: Field "{{name}}" of type {{type}} only supports sources: {{sources}}.
configValidate.fieldOptions: Field "{{name}}" with mockStatic source needs at least one option.
configValidate.fieldApi: Field "{{name}}" with api source needs an endpoint.
configValidate.fieldRelationTarget: Field "{{name}}" with relation source needs a target module.
configValidate.fieldRelationLabel: Field "{{name}}" with relation source needs a label field.
configValidate.fieldCriteria: Field "{{name}}" of type {{type}} does not support criteria {{criteria}}.
configValidate.fieldSubs: Field "{{name}}" needs at least one sub-field.
configValidate.subNameReserved: Sub-field name "{{name}}" is reserved for system columns.
configValidate.subNoNested: Sub-fields cannot be form arrays (one level max).
configValidate.subSource: Sub-field "{{name}}" of type {{type}} only supports sources: {{sources}}.
configValidate.subOptions: Sub-field "{{name}}" with mockStatic source needs at least one option.
configValidate.subApi: Sub-field "{{name}}" with api source needs an endpoint.
configValidate.subRelationTarget: Sub-field "{{name}}" with relation source needs a target module.
configValidate.subRelationLabel: Sub-field "{{name}}" with relation source needs a label field.
configValidate.iconNameRequired: Icon name must be a lucide-react component name (e.g. Database).
configValidate.defKey: Key must be a unique kebab path (e.g. region, mater-data/company).
configValidate.defDeleteMode: Delete mode must be hard or soft.
configValidate.defStatus: Status must be draft or published.
configValidate.layoutKind: Kind must be field, section, or divider.
configValidate.layoutIdConflict: Id "{{name}}" conflicts with a field name.
configValidate.layoutDup: Item "{{name}}" is duplicated in the layout.
configValidate.layoutMissingForm: Field "{{name}}" is not in the form layout yet.
configValidate.layoutDupTable: Field "{{name}}" is duplicated in the table order.
configValidate.layoutMissingTable: Field "{{name}}" is not in the table order yet.
configValidate.layoutHiddenInOrder: Field "{{name}}" is hidden but not in the order.
configValidate.layoutDupDetail: Field "{{name}}" is duplicated in the detail order.
configValidate.layoutMissingDetail: Field "{{name}}" is not in the detail order yet.
configValidate.defI18n: Module translations must map language codes to key/value string pairs.

detail.canvasHint: Drag rows from anywhere to arrange. Click a row to edit properties.
detail.systemRowNote: System row — always shown. Order (drag) and display style are adjustable.
detail.testHint: Fill the form then Create — rows are saved as sample data (not to the mock store), used for List & Detail previews, then continue to the next step.
detail.needFields: Add fields in the form canvas first.
detail.dragHint: Drag from anywhere to move • click to edit properties

field.label: Label
field.name: Name
field.subEmpty: No columns yet. Add at least one sub-field.
field.validationHint: Check a rule and fill its value. Clearing a value removes the rule.
field.sortableDesc: Column can be sorted in the table.
field.filterableDesc: Shown in the list page filter.
field.noModules: No registered modules yet — publish the target module first.
field.relationHint: Options come from the target module records (search + paging included).
field.clearableHint: X button to clear the input.
field.uploadMultiple: On = pick many files, File[] value.
field.arrayEmptyDescPh: Click the button below to add rows.
field.lockFirstRowHint: First row always exists and cannot be deleted.
field.addModeHint: Modal = editor dialog first; append = add an empty row directly.

generate.writtenRegistered: {{count}} files written to repo. Routes + navigation registered.
generate.registeredAuto: {{count}} route(s) + navigation auto-registered — module is ready to open.

list.propFreezeActionDesc: Action column sticks on horizontal scroll.
list.pageSizeNote: Page size follows the URL parameter.
list.configNote: List & Create features are set in the Config step.
list.systemColumnNote: System column — always shown with system defaults. Order (drag) and width are adjustable.
list.canvasHint: Drag from anywhere on headers to reorder • click a header to edit properties • hover column edges to resize width.
list.dragHint: Drag from anywhere on the header to move • click to edit properties
list.emptyDesc: Fill in the Live Preview step — headers stay draggable.
list.actionVisibilityHint: Actions appear when the feature is enabled and the user has its permission.
list.emptyHint: Leave blank to use the default wording.

modules.intro_plural: {{count}} modules created. Edit loads the definition into the Builder; Generate to repo writes static source (only under `npm run dev`).

modules.repoDeleted: Module "{{key}}" also removed from repo ({{count}} paths).

wizard.loadConfirm: The running draft will be discarded and replaced with module "{{key}}". Continue?
wizard.publishedLive: Module "{{key}}" is live in navigation + routes.
wizard.validateParentUnknown: Unknown parent module. Pick from the list or create a new parent.
wizard.validatePermissionInvalid: Permission key must be a single lowercase value (e.g. user, audit_trail).
wizard.validateBulkList: Bulk upload & export need the list feature.
wizard.validateFieldRequired: Add at least one field from the palette.
wizard.publishIssues: {{count}} definition issues: {{shown}} Check the previous steps again.
wizard.publishIssuesMore: {{count}} definition issues: {{shown}}… Check the previous steps again.
